text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 131, December 23, 1937 ]
DIRECTING THE DIRECTOR OF MINES PERSONALLY, OR THROUGH HIS AUTHORIZED
REPRESENTATIVES, TO CONDUCT UNDERGROUND MINE INSPECTIONS IN REPRESENTATION
OF THE SECRETARY OF LABOR
I, MANUEL L. QUEZON, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do
hereby order and direct that for the purpose of effectively enforcing the provisions of Commonwealth Act
Numbered One hundred and four and the rules and regulations issued there under, the Director of Mines
personally, or through his authorized representatives shall, for and in representation of the Secretary of Labor,
inspect periodically all underground workings of mines, and shall report to the said Secretary of Labor for
appropriate action any violations of the safety rules and regulations governing mining operations or any
unsafe condition found to exist therein.
The Director of Mines shall recommend from time to time to the Secretary of Labor, for consideration of the
said Secretary and the Advisory Safety Council, any additions to, or changes in, the safety rules and
regulations governing mining operations as he may find desirable.
Done at the City of Manila, this twenty-third day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-seven, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the third.
(Sgd.) MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(Sgd.) ELPIDIO QUIRINO
Secretary of the Interior
